title: Six More Short Answers
label: ch:ml-five-more-short-answers
canDo: I can ask for something, accept, refuse, and ask for more or less in Malayalam.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-C58-that-will-do and say all six words in order, beginning with the one that makes the offer.
payoff.note: venam was moved here from a later chapter rather than taught where it was first needed: ML-C58-no-need names it as 'the negative partner of venam', so teaching it later made that a forward reference eighty lessons early. It now sits immediately before its own negative.
